title: Capstone: URL shortener
prompt: Capstone: design a URL shortener. Candidate invents a new consensus protocol before a short_code→url table and cache. Redirect?

choices.label: Require read/write paths using data-model + caching lessons; no new mechanism
choices.consequence: Capstone reuses earlier slugs: data-model for the mapping, caching for hot redirects — not a novel consensus toy.

choices.label: Encourage the new protocol as creativity
choices.consequence: Hour vanishes without a working redirect path.

choices.label: Store links on a public chain
choices.consequence: Latency and cost fight a read-heavy redirector.

choices.label: Use only DNS CNAMEs, no app storage
choices.consequence: Cannot map arbitrary codes to long URLs cleanly.
